hook: The Old Lord Who Fell at the Coronation
text: Among the peers who came forward at Queen Victoria's coronation was Lord Rolle, a very old man of nearly ninety. As he climbed the steps toward the throne, he stumbled and fell, and rolled back down to the bottom. He was not hurt, and he insisted on trying again. Seeing this, the young Queen rose from her throne and stepped down towards him, so that he would not have to climb so far. The people in the Abbey were moved by her kindness, and it was spoken of for a long time.
